scientific_choices.choice: Paper sections3.3-3.5 support original RGB crops/PARSeq/context; this CLIP extension is confined to APPROXIMATE.
Reuse original v1 pools, unchanged boxes, captions, scores and target-covered surrounding controls with verified contracts; old implementation/results remain untouched.
Score the word-specific loss of CLIP agreement when its target letters are removed: surround cosine minus target-masked surround cosine; raw/written/ensemble/context-residual probes.

Render each complete raw PARSeq candidate in three SHA-bound fonts and two polarities; normalized mean image embeddings act as a synthetic glyph query, with square-canvas and anisotropically stretched variants. No new OCR candidate or GT word is generated.

Bicubic square stretching increases visible text size while deforming glyphs; compare image-to-text and image-to-image retrieval, equal mean across two views and fixed confidence/visible-letter/glyph agreement gates.

Compare a candidate's rendered glyphs against the same raw characters in reverse order, keeping all characters and never inserting the reversed string into the OCR pool; identical reversals/palindromes give zero order evidence.
Sequential frozen float32 CLIP processes, batch16/four CPU threads, explicit CPU or single-GPU execution, deterministic seeds/settings, cached CPU feature reuse within one model.

Font/style/word-length shortcuts, target-masking artifacts, spelling discrimination, calibration and independent TEST transfer. Pretrained spelling-subspace projections remain a researched future direction, not a silently substituted component.
